dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Really not going to play another round, Instructor?

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: I've already got my best score on the board. You saw — I'm getting a bit too old for this. Up against this fancy new wargame, the most I can do is scrape by with a passing grade...

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: But the passing grade is sixty percent of Captain Chevreuse's score! Outside of you, everybody else flunked, so where's the "too old" coming from...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: If you don't shoot now, I'll never see you holding a musket again.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I didn't even feel it coming on. How did the time go by so quickly...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Eh? What're you crying for, kiddo?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: I'm just retiring. It's not like we'll never see each other again!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: You want to see me, easy enough — pick a place, treat me to dinner once a week.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Yes, yes, yes — not just buttered Tidalga, you can pick the Hotel Debord for all I care!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: But... maybe not every week... how about once a month?

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Whatever. Whatever you arrange, I can take.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: But seriously, though... from now on, all the new recruits we've got are yours.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Keep a good eye on Marine and Roxane — make sure they don't lose themselves in the work.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: And don't let the recruits come up short of where you were back in the day. The moment any of them slacks off, give 'em a swift kick in the rear!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I will! A swift kick in the rear!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Good. My sisters are calling me down to Natlan for a vacation. I might be out of Fontaine for a couple of months...

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: And when I'm back from vacation, I'll be coming to inspect your results!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I won't let you down, Instructor!
